name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: We need to add a single high-contrast skip link at the top of every page, jumping directly to the main content. This is the best option because it allows keyboard-only users and screen readers to bypass unnecessary navigation, improving their overall experience. By doing this, we're accepting the trade-off of adding a potentially distracting element for mouse users, but it's a small price to pay for significantly improving accessibility. This skip link will be especially crucial for mobile and touch users who may struggle with complex navigation.

name: Reader
text: Risk: A single skip link fails on pages with multiple distinct content sections—screen-reader users get stuck jumping to the same spot every time. Better alternative: context-aware skip links that adapt to each page’s structure. Settle it by testing with real users on pages with varied layouts.
